results.summary: A flat of 66,5 m2 in a revitalised tenement house at ul. Trakt św. Wojciecha in Gdańsk Orunia, consisting of a living room, two bedrooms, a separate kitchen, a bathroom with WC and a corridor. The layout allows four independent rooms to be separated; the flat was thoroughly renovated about 5 years ago and needs refreshing, but can be occupied immediately. The building has only 2 floors and a large yard where parking is possible, and the monthly rent is about 630 zł.

A flat of 39,76 m² on the ground floor of the Solvo development at ul. Krynickiej 2 in Gdańsk, built in 2017, with a south-eastern exposure. A storage unit of 1,61 m² and a ground-level parking space on a closed car park are priced separately from the flat. The property is sold directly by the owner, without intermediaries.

results.summary: A two-room flat of 36m2 on the primary market, in a development in Łostowice in the southern part of Gdańsk. The surroundings include greenery and the areas along Potok Maćkowy, with a school, a nursery, shops and service premises nearby, and the estate itself has a playground and an activity zone. The buildings have photovoltaic installations on the roofs, LED lighting in the common areas, external monitoring and video intercoms, and anti-burglary doors are fitted in the flats.

A flat of 27,60 m2 in Rzęsna, in the Rudniki district of Gdańsk, consisting of one room, a separate kitchen, a hallway and a bathroom, situated on the second floor. The interior is due for refreshing but the flat is fit to be lived in. The four-storey building is managed by the Spółdzielnia Mieszkaniowa „Długie Ogrody”, free parking spaces for residents are available in front of it, heating and water are municipal, and the administrative fees come to about 600 zł per month.
